detail.title: Causal-Guided Adaptive Editing for Foundational Assumptions
detail.summary: Causal-guided adaptive knowledge editing (CAKE) enables targeted modification of foundational model premises. When integrated with incident analysis workflows, such editing helps correct systemic reasoning errors observed in diagnostic tasks like root cause analysis.
detail.reason: Synthesizing CAKE findings with RCA-specific LLM performance data to address foundational error correction.
